description: You are a Regulatory Affairs Manager at PrecisionOffice Components. You have a regulatory submission deadline in 48 hours and must formally close out a supplier non-conformance record before that deadline. Find the quality alert titled 'Surface Coating Defect on Cabinet Batch 2025-Q1' and complete the following regulatory closure actions: (1) enter a corrective action documenting the immediate containment measures taken for the defective batch, (2) enter a preventive action documenting the supplier process change or incoming inspection enhancement to prevent recurrence, (3) change the priority to 'Urgent' to reflect the regulatory significance, (4) assign any existing partner or company from the system to the alert as the responsible vendor, and (5) transition the alert to the 'Done' stage to formally close the corrective action record. Additionally, to prevent similar surface coating defects from going undetected in the future, create a new 'Pass/Fail' type quality control point for the 'Acoustic Bloc Screens' product with a failure message describing what action to take when coating inspection fails. Log in to the quality management system at http://localhost:8069 with username admin and password admin.
